env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Navigates the repository and identifies code locations (files, classes, functions) that need to be edited to resolve the issue.
env_context_strategy.note: Paper-only; READ/LIST/COMMAND actions used for exploration.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Executes the command in a shell with timeout and truncation of large results.
context_compaction.note: READ also returns lazy signature-only representations. Paper-only.

observation_format.evidence_quote: When reading a file, only signatures of the top level definitions are presented

tool_call_format.note: Action syntax (e.g. READ(file, class, function)) shown but parsing mechanism not reported; no code in bundle.

tool_count.evidence_quote: 7. DONE: Used by the agent to signal that it has completed its assigned objective.
tool_count.note: Union of actions READ, EDIT, ADD, WRITE, LIST, COMMAND, DONE; each sub-agent sees a subset (e.g. 5 for Test Template Generator).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: For each edit, the Fixer expects the LLM to output the original version of the code snippet (pre) followed by the edited version of this snippet (post).
edit_primitive.note: Pre/post with line numbers and fuzzy matching; WRITE(file, contents) writes full files (tests).

tool_schema_source.note: No code; schema source not described.

protocol_standardization.note: No source tree to grep; paper silent.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The sub-agents are composed by passing the output from one sub-agent to the input of another sub-agent.
loop_primitives.note: Sub-agents use ReAct; Fixer samples 5 patches and Ranker selects (multi_attempt).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Instead of treating this as one long chain of reasoning and actions, we propose modularizing the problem into sub-problems and delegating them to different sub-agents.
planning_granularity.note: Decomposition is fixed by design, no stored plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We instantiate 5 sub-agents to collectively resolve repository-level issues.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the sub-agents are given modular objectives that do not require explicit one-to-one or group conversations between sub-agents.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: fixed output-to-input handoff between sub-agents; each sub-agent likely a separate context.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: alternates between generating an action to take using an LLM followed by executing the action and using the resulting observations as input for the subsequent action generation
short_term_state.note: Edit Localizer also keeps marked edit locations.

self_verification.evidence_quote: For each of the patches, Ranker first runs the test on each of the patches and then asks the LLM to determine whether the application of that patch to the repository has caused the provided test to change status
self_verification.note: Syntactically incorrect edits are rejected (linters_typecheck); Ranker is a separate CoT sub-agent (llm_judge).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: It retries upto a specified limit or until it finds a template that works.
retry_policy.note: Applies to Test Template Generator (3 retries); whole-task is single pass with 5 Fixer samples.

rollback.note: Paper mentions discarding edits to pre-existing tests; no rollback mechanism described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: We limit the ReAct loops of the Test Template Generator, Issue Reproducer, and Edit Localizer to 25 steps

cost_controls.note: Average cost reported, no budget mechanism described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Executes the command in a shell with timeout and truncation of large results.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated with SWE-bench Lite harness externally; repo code absent.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Syntactically incorrect edits are rejected and the resultant patches are used downstream.
